segments.title: 第147章 查房
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 147: The Room Check

"I just came back home to spend some time with my daughter. Why did you have to tag along?"

In the nanny van, Yuan Wanqing sat in the backseat's rest area, looking at Luo Fei who had forcefully squeezed her way into the car, a speechless expression on her face. "Aren't you going home to your significant other?"

"I haven't seen Zhusheng in a long time either. Can't I follow you back and freeload a meal?" Luo Fei rolled her eyes at her, then muttered, "Besides, there's a good show to watch."

"What did you say?"

"Nothing." Luo Fei chuckled twice, then changed the subject. "You've finished recording 'Annual Rings.' Your workload should have lightened up quite a bit recently, right?"

"This is how it is for a has-been artist." Yuan Wanqing smiled helplessly. "I've just let down Director Ying's expectations."

"He was the one who pushed for this comeback against all opposition. A pity, it's truly hard to go against the tide of the times."

"I used to dream that I could return to my former peak after my comeback. Now it seems it's better to accept the reality that I'm an old-timer sooner rather than later."

"You're being a little too self-deprecating." Luo Fei shook her head and said, "It's not that you've gotten worse, or that the artists now have genuinely improved. It's just that in the current internet era, the ways and means for a person to become famous have logically changed."

"What's more, with digital albums becoming more and more developed and piracy running rampant, the phase where singers could make huge sales just by selling albums is over."

"If you don't have online traffic, you even have to pay your own way in to get exposure on popular variety shows. The prices for various commercial performances and gigs won't go up, and brands won't look for you for endorsements."

"And your work is just one way of obtaining traffic, and it's not even the only one."

"These days, cracking jokes and being funny on a variety show is more useful than singing a good song."

Yuan Wanqing listened to Luo Fei say all this, knowing her friend was comforting her. She rested her chin on her hand and looked at the streetscape outside the window, her heart calming down.

When she debuted at the beginning of the century, she became an instant hit, but she only really made money for two or three years. Later, she went abroad for treatment. For over ten years, she wasn't as wealthy as outsiders imagined.

But even so, she definitely had enough money.

Even though this comeback wasn't effective and didn't make much of a splash, she could still rely on the company's channels and resources to take on some commercial performances and gigs, and the pay was far more handsome than what ordinary people imagined.

She no longer had the mentality of a little girl, without a grand goal of having to become some famous figure.

Now that her comeback had failed, Yuan Wanqing had gradually accepted this result, planning to shift some of her thoughts and life's focus back onto Yan Zhusheng.

At the very least, she should come back to spend time with her daughter every weekend from now on.

Otherwise, it wasn't good to frequently leave her at home alone.

"It's a shame the company has been transforming these past few years, and its internal resources have completely skewed toward film and television."

Luo Fei was still talking nonstop, "The quality of the songs they solicit for you really can't be called top-tier. It can only be described as decent."

"They said it was tailor-made, but really only that song, 'Drifting Like a Dream,' is a solid track, but it mostly resonates with old fans."

"But in the internet age, it's the young people's world. The percentage of older people who still surf the internet is really not high."

"Alright." Yuan Wanqing waved her hand with a smile. "After all that, you're still just trying to counsel me. I'm not as fragile as you think."

"I just don't want you to sink into complete depression." Luo Fei sighed. "These days, sometimes an opportunity comes when you least expect it. You have to be ready to catch it at any moment."

"It's not as easy as you say." Yuan Wanqing shook her head. "In any case, life goes on. What do you want for dinner? I'll have the cooking auntie prepare it in advance."

"Then she might need to prepare quite a bit more," Luo Fei said in a small voice.

"What?"

"Nothing." Luo Fei stifled a laugh. "I'll eat anything. You can arrange it."

Yuan Wanqing took out her phone and called the cooking auntie.

After the call connected, she said a few simple words, only to hear the other person say:

"Your daughter called me today and said I don't need to come over to cook. You see, this..."

"Hmm?" Yuan Wanqing was taken aback. "Did she say why?"

"I didn't ask about that," the cooking auntie said. "After all, this has been going on for a long time. For the past two months, she often tells me I don't need to come over on Saturday nights. It's usually the Sunday noon meal that she asks me to make."

"Is that so." Yuan Wanqing fell silent for a moment, it was unclear what she was thinking. Finally, she nodded and said, "I see. I'll ask Zhusheng about it first."

After hanging up, Yuan Wanqing looked at Luo Fei, who was covering her mouth and snickering, and immediately gave her a suspicious look. "You, do you know something?"

"I only know a tiny bit."

"Then spit it out."

"Aren't we about to arrive at your place? You can see for yourself."

Hearing her say that, Yuan Wanqing fell into deep thought and then had a few guesses.

After the nanny van drove into the residential complex and parked in the garage, Yuan Wanqing and Luo Fei got out and walked toward the house.

The elevator went all the way up. Yuan Wanqing took out her house keys, opened the door, and invited Luo Fei in, then glanced at the floor of the entryway.

Besides Yan Zhusheng's shoes, there was a pair of larger-sized sneakers that clearly belonged to a boy.

"It's Li Luo, isn't it?" Yuan Wanqing glanced at Luo Fei and pursed her lips. "I don't know what you're so excited about."

"You guessed it already?" Luo Fei was stunned for a moment. "How come you seem so familiar with it?"

"I met him during the parent-teacher conference, we even had a meal together." Yuan Wanqing said simply. "But you, how did you know in advance that he would be here?"

"I received an email from him a couple of days ago. It was Zhusheng who asked me to help with two arrangements," Luo Fei said with a shrug. "She said they were going to record songs over the weekend, so I guessed that Li Luo would come over."

Yuan Wanqing shot her a glare, finally understanding why this woman insisted on coming over to freeload a meal today.

But she was also a little curious. "How does Li Luo have new songs again?"

"Never underestimate the mind of a young person." Luo Fei remarked with a sigh. "Pop songs aren't that difficult to begin with. I think they sound quite good, and some melodies are very catchy."

"Then let's go have a listen." As Yuan Wanqing spoke, she had already changed into her slippers and was heading toward the recording studio on the second floor.

Luo Fei quickly followed, her face full of excitement, looking every bit like someone who enjoys stirring up trouble.

The two of them walked all the way to the door of the recording studio on the second floor.

The recording studio in Yuan Wanqing's home was built with special soundproofing materials.

But that didn't mean not a single sound could be heard.

At least after reaching the door, one could still hear the commotion inside.

Only, it didn't sound like they were recording a song right now. Instead, the faint sounds of two people talking could be heard.

Originally, Yuan Wanqing had wanted to knock directly on the door, but in the next second, her hand froze.

"Li Luo, a little softer here."

"I don't quite understand just from you saying that."

"It's like... I'll teach you."

Then, a burst of singing came from inside.

"Right here, listen carefully. The enunciation here can be a bit lighter, giving it an ethereal feeling. Yours is too solid."

Hearing this, Yuan Wanqing's expression finally softened. She raised her hand and knocked on the door.

The recording studio instantly fell silent.

Soon, after a sound of footsteps, Yan Zhusheng opened the door from the inside.

When she saw her mother and Luo Fei, her face froze for a moment. "Why are you here?"

"I didn't have much to do this weekend, so I came back to see you." Yuan Wanqing glanced at Li Luo inside, then asked, "I'm not disturbing you, am I?"

Yan Zhusheng blinked, then shook her head. After stepping aside, she let Yuan Wanqing and Luo Fei in.

"Long time no see, Zhusheng." Luo Fei walked in happily, immediately hugging Yan Zhusheng and kneading and pinching her face with both hands. "Come, give a smile. See how pretty you are when you smile."

"Auntie Luo Fei, we still have to record," Yan Zhusheng said, letting Luo Fei play with her face with a deadpan expression.

"Sigh..." Luo Fei sighed and let go. "She was cuter when she was little. Not as fun now that she's grown up."

After speaking, Luo Fei turned to Li Luo and said with a smile, "You must be Li Luo, right? I've heard so much about you. I finally get to meet you."

"Hello, Auntie." Li Luo greeted politely. "Thank you for helping with the arrangements for the previous few songs."

"You should thank Zhusheng. I've watched her grow up. The arrangements were a small matter."

"So you have a guest over, why didn't you ask the cooking auntie to come?" Yuan Wanqing asked instead. "Are you not planning to eat at home?"

"Auntie, it's a misunderstanding." Li Luo explained, "We bought some groceries on the way here. We plan to cook a meal after we're done recording, as a way of thanking her for helping me record."

"You can cook?" Luo Fei was surprised.

"And it's delicious," Yan Zhusheng said seriously. "More delicious than the cooking auntie's."

"Then I must have a taste." Luo Fei said with a beaming smile. "You don't mind, do you, Li Luo?"

"Of course not." Li Luo smiled. "As long as you two aunties don't find it wanting."

"Dinner isn't urgent." Yuan Wanqing's gaze fell on the microphone in the recording studio and the lyrics beside it. "Let me hear your new song first, how about it?"

Li Luo nodded.

And so Yan Zhusheng, who was beside him, took the over-ear headphones that had been set aside and put them back on Li Luo.

Yuan Wanqing watched this scene, her eyes flickering slightly.

(End of this chapter)
